scripts.build-db: node -e "const sqlite3 = require('sqlite3').verbose(); const fs = require('fs'); const db = new sqlite3.Database('./database.db'); const schema = fs.readFileSync('./db_schema.sql', 'utf8'); db.exec(schema, (err) => { if (err) console.error('Error:', err); else console.log('Database created successfully!'); db.close(); });"
